en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an alpine landscape. In the foreground at left there is a wooden roadside crucifix or shrine with a figure of Christ hanging beneath the overhanging roof. In the background are two striking rocky mountain peaks rising above forested slopes and a winding path in the valley. The image is framed by a white border with an Italian caption printed below the photograph.
